summary:
All 14 acceptance criteria hold at bd556e5. The O-015 fix works, and I measured that myself rather than relying on the build's report. No acceptance criterion or obligation is left open.

What passed on this tree:
- Core tests: 120/120.
- Fitness (rebuilt): all 20 rules hold.
- rules-parity: AGREE.
- WindowCases -Case All: all 15 cases passed in 153 s. C-006 stopped the scan at 550 of 30,150 folders. C-012 and O-016 each exited 70 with the planted stale report gone.
- WindowMutants -Mutant All: all 8 mutants passed in 274 s, each failing its case for exactly the planted reason.
  - CancelThrows logged 'rethrown', the app exited 70, and C-006 failed only on 'exit code' and 'a report was written'.
  - HookFailsAfterActing failed C-006 only on the new 'the hook did not fail after it acted' check.
- Repeat on one warm 30,150-folder tree, 15 runs per mode:
  - stop: 15/15 Cancelled with a 'Stopped:' title, at 550-750 folders.
  - close and throw: 15/15 exit 70 each, with no report and the stale report gone.
  - The hook acted at 340-927 ms, and every run read enabled=True visible=True.

My own probes:
- O-015 cross-check: I combined CancelThrows with the crash handler removed. C-006 then exited 0xE0434352 instead of 70. So the exception the hook re-raises really does reach the dispatcher unhandled, and with the handler present the 70 comes from the app's own crash handler.
- O-002: I ran C-006's own main step, text taken verbatim from the committed Test-C006, against a tree so small the scan ends before the hook can act. Across 10 runs on a small tree and 10 on an empty tree, every run failed on 'the hook acted' alone, never on an ending mismatch. The hook logged 'refused ... the app shut down first'.
- Criteria 13 and 14 re-measured:
  - Unknown modes 'bogus' and 'STOP': the hook refused, the app ran to Completed, and CheckActed failed.
  - A relative dll path, or one containing ';': the host exited 0xE0434352 with an empty log.

Afterwards no processes, temp folders or hook variables were left behind, and git status is unchanged.

No loop: build-slice ran twice. The second attempt was sent back by my attempt-1 finding (O-015) and fixed it. It changed only tests, and this slice is tests-only by design.

Contact is `code`, not `real`: every run used generated trees under %TEMP% on this one Windows 11 PC.

checks.what: Repo-local SDK and published exe present
checks.evidence: 10.0.401. The exe is 139,777,176 bytes and newer than every source file, so Update-App did not republish. At the start: 0 FsAnalyser.App processes, the fsa-window-* temp folders empty, and no hook variables set.
20 rules checked against 46 files; every declared rule holds, including SL-033's three (no test seam in src, no code shared between hook and app, the hook never sets the outcome).

checks.what: Full window suite, including the three hooked cases
checks.evidence:
exit 0 in 153 s; PASSED C-001..C-014 and O-016.
- C-006:
  - pwsh control exited 0xE0434352.
  - Inert pwsh exited 0 with an empty log.
  - Cleanup removed all 3 variables.
  - No-scan step: the hook refused after 20 s, last seen enabled=True visible=False.
  - Main run: acted at ms=639, the new after-acting check passed, stopped after 550 of 30,150 folders with a 'Stopped:' title.
- C-012: acted at ms=517, exit 70 (0x46), stale report gone.
- O-016: acted at ms=632, exit 70, stale report gone.
Passed! Failed 0, Passed 120, Skipped 0, Total 120, 9 s.
rules-parity: AGREE 7 facts <- 10 twinned entries, 21 patterns; exit 0.

checks.what: O-002 / criterion 2 probe: C-006's committed main step (text taken verbatim from Test-C006 by AST) with the tree swapped so the scan ends before the hook can act
checks.evidence: small tree (20 files, 4 folders) 10/10 and empty tree 10/10. Every run's only FAIL was 'the hook acted (...); if not, the hook never acted...'. Nothing was printed about exit code, core.status or OutcomeTitle, because CheckActed returns first. Hook log in all 20: 'loaded | waiting found=True enabled=True visible=False | refused mode=stop reason=the app shut down first'. envLeft 0. 13 s.

checks.what: O-015 cross-check: CancelThrows combined with NoCrashHandler, in a scratch copy (functions taken from the committed WindowMutants.ps1)
checks.evidence: The hook logged 'acted mode=stop ... ms=637' and then 'rethrown mode=stop reason=InvalidOperationException: validate2: OnCancel threw'. C-006 got exit -532462766 (0xE0434352) and no report. So the re-raised exception is unhandled on the dispatcher; with the handler present (the CancelThrows mutant) the same path gives the app's 70. Scratch copy removed.

checks.what: Mutation proofs: every hooked case fails against its mutant, for the planted reason only
checks.evidence:
exit 0 in 274 s, PASSED all 8.
- StopDisabled: the hook saw enabled=False and never acted; the single FAIL was 'the hook acted'.
- StopCollapsed: never saw the button visible; same single FAIL.
- NoCrashHandler: single FAIL, 'actual -532462766 (0xE0434352)'.
- NoExitRule: single FAIL, 'actual 0 (0x00000000)'.
- CancelThrows: log showed 'rethrown mode=stop ...'; FAILs exactly 'exit code' (actual '70') and 'a report was written'.
- HookFailsAfterActing: single FAIL, 'the hook did not fail after it acted'.
- HookCompileError: error CS1029 shown, Update-Hook stopped the run, C-006 never started, earlier dll unchanged.
- HookLocked: error MSB3027/MSB3021 shown, with the same result.

checks.what: Repeat, first try: invocation error on my side
checks.evidence: pwsh -File passed 'stop,close,throw' as ONE string, so the hook got an unknown mode. Result: refused 15/15, exit 0, Completed at 30,150/30,150. This is my mistake, not the slice's, though it is 15 more data points for criterion 13. Re-run correctly below.

checks.evidence:
- stop: acted 15/15, refused 0, exit 0 x15, reports 15, Cancelled x15, title 'Stopped: <root>', 550-750 folders.
- close: acted 15/15, exit 70 x15, no reports, stale report gone 15/15, no .tmp.

checks.command: Get-Process FsAnalyser.App; Get-ChildItem %TEMP%\fsa-window-{cases,hook,mutants}; env; git status --short

checks.what: Update-Hook against a REAL leftover FsAnalyser.App.exe holding the dll
checks.evidence: Not repeated this attempt. Attempt 1 measured it at 105f1a4 (MSB3027 'locked by FsAnalyser.App (31620)', exit 1, dll unchanged). Update-Hook has not changed since (the diff 105f1a4..bd556e5 touches only StartupHook.cs Act handling, CheckActed and WindowMutants). The committed HookLocked mutant (a FileStream stand-in) passed this run.

checks.what: A real input-driven press (mouse or UIA) on a CancelButton whose handler throws
checks.evidence: The stack rules out UIA, FlaUI and WinAppDriver, and I may not drive another program's windows. My cross-check shows the hook's re-raise lands as an unhandled dispatcher exception. That a real click lands in the same place is still reasoning about WPF.

criteria.criterion: 1. stop the scan (C-006) when Stop is pressable and the scan is running on the 30,150-folder New-LargeTree
criteria.how: C-006 in -Case All passed (acted ms=639, exit 0, schema 1, Cancelled, 'Stopped:' title, 550/30,150). 15-run repeat: 15/15 Cancelled at 550-750 folders.

criteria.criterion: 2. stop the scan (C-006) when the scan finishes before the hook acts (tree too small, or a warm cache)
criteria.how: I fed the literal shape: C-006's verbatim main step on a small and an empty tree, 20/20. Each run failed only on 'the hook acted', never on an ending mismatch. The warm-cache repeat never let the scan win (worst case 750 of 30,150). Test-C006 still builds New-LargeTree. The committed StopCollapsed and StopDisabled mutants show the same observable, with the scan Completed and no acted line, and each fails only on 'the hook acted'.

criteria.criterion: 3. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is IsEnabled=false during the scan (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: WindowMutants StopDisabled: the hook logged 'waiting ... enabled=False', never acted, and C-006 failed once, on 'the hook acted'.

criteria.criterion: 4. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is Visibility=Collapsed during the scan (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: WindowMutants StopCollapsed: never visible, never acted, C-006 failed once, on 'the hook acted'.

criteria.criterion: 5. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is pressable before StartScan begins (XAML default is enabled)
criteria.how: C-006's no-scan step in -Case All: the hook saw 'enabled=True visible=False', did not press, and refused after 20 s. None of the 45 repeat runs logged a 'waiting' line before acting.

criteria.criterion: 6. exit-70 path (C-012): unhandled dispatcher exception mid-scan, handler present, stale report planted
criteria.how: C-012 passed (acted ms=517, exit 70 (0x46), stale report gone, no .tmp). Throw repeat: 15/15 exit 70, stale report gone 15/15.

criteria.criterion: 7. exit-70 path (C-012) with the DispatcherUnhandledException handler removed (scratch mutant)
8. closed before the first ending (O-016): window closed while Stop is pressable, report mode, stale report planted
criteria.how: O-016 passed (acted ms=632, exit 70, stale report gone, no .tmp). Close repeat: 15/15 exit 70, 0 reports, stale report gone 15/15.

criteria.criterion: 9. closed before the first ending (O-016) with the Exit handler's exit-0-without-a-file to 70 rule removed (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: NoExitRule: O-016 failed once, 'actual 0 (0x00000000)'. So the unmutated 70 comes from the Exit rule, not from a crash.

criteria.criterion: 10. hooked run cleanup when a case throws or fails after the three variables are set
criteria.how: C-006's cleanup step passed: the throw reached the case and all 3 variables were removed. After 45 repeat runs, 20 O-002 probe runs, 4 criterion 13/14 probes and all mutants, no hook variable was left set.

criteria.criterion: 11. load the hook: a non-App .NET host inherits the variables (pwsh 7 with FSA_HOOK_MODE=close)
criteria.how: -Case All: the control (a missing dll) made pwsh exit 0xE0434352, so pwsh does run startup hooks. Under the real hook in close mode pwsh exited 0 and the log was empty.

criteria.criterion: 12. build the hook: compile error, or dll locked by a leftover FsAnalyser.App.exe
criteria.how: HookCompileError (CS1029) and HookLocked (MSB3027/3021) each stopped the run in Update-Hook with exit 1, C-006 never started, and the earlier dll was unchanged. A real leftover app locking the dll was measured in attempt 1; Update-Hook has not changed since.

criteria.criterion: 13. select a mode: FSA_HOOK_MODE is an unknown string
criteria.how: 'bogus' and 'STOP' each logged 'refused ... unknown mode', the app ran to Completed with exit 0, and CheckActed failed. My mis-invoked repeat added 15 more runs with the unknown mode 'stop,close,throw', with the same result.

criteria.criterion: 14. locate the hook dll: the path is relative, or contains ';'
criteria.how: Each made the host exit 0xE0434352 with an empty log, and CheckActed failed, so the case cannot pass silently. The committed $HookDll is fully qualified, and the repo path has no ';'.

obligations.evidence: The shape is fed and handled as the obligation requires. (1) The committed test that feeds a run whose scan ends Completed with no 'acted' line is `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant StopCollapsed` (StopDisabled works the same way). Measured this run: C-006 exited 1 and its single FAIL was 'the hook acted ... the hook never acted and nothing after it is this case's ending', not an ending mismatch. (2) The literal 'tree too small' shape is not committed, so I fed it myself: C-006's main step, text verbatim from Test-C006, on a small and an empty tree. 20/20 runs failed only on 'the hook acted', and the hook logged 'refused ... the app shut down first'. (3) The tree stays large: Test-C006 builds New-LargeTree, and on a warm cache the scan was stopped at 550-750 of 30,150 folders in 15/15 runs (hook acted at ms 340-927).

Measured at bd556e5 (already discharged at model contact; this is code contact). The CancelThrows mutant logged 'rethrown mode=stop ...'; the app exited 70 with no report, and C-006 failed exactly on 'exit code' and 'a report was written'. HookFailsAfterActing made C-006 fail only on 'the hook did not fail after it acted'. My cross-check (CancelThrows plus the crash handler removed) exited 0xE0434352. So the re-raised exception reaches the dispatcher unhandled, and the 70 comes from App.DispatcherUnhandledException, not from the hook.

not_reached: A real input-driven press (mouse or UIA) on a CancelButton whose handler throws. I measured that the hook's re-raise lands as an unhandled dispatcher exception. That a real click behaves the same is reasoning about WPF, not a measurement.

A close-path crash regression. O-016 cannot tell the Exit rule's 70 apart from the crash handler's 70; both give exit 70 and no report. On this tree NoExitRule shows the 70 comes from the Exit rule. But a future OnClosing fault would still pass O-016, and no mutant covers it.
A machine where Windows Error Reporting shows a crash dialog. With the crash handler removed there, C-012 would likely show TIMEOUT rather than 0xE0434352. Here the process ended at once.
Windows 10. Everything ran on Windows 11 26200 only.
Other .NET hosts inheriting the hook variables (dotnet.exe, MSBuild nodes). Only pwsh 7 was checked.

Much faster or slower disks and CPUs. On this machine the hook acted at 340-927 ms, with the scan stopped at 550-750 of 30,150 folders. The margin on a much faster machine is unmeasured, though O-002's handling means such a run fails as 'hook never acted', not silently.
Any real user data or drive. Every run used generated trees under %TEMP%, which is why contact is code, not real.
